item.title: Wakayama Girls' Trip: Onsen Towns, Cute Cafes & Spiritual Experiences
item.description: Wakayama offers something increasingly rare in Japanese travel: the possibility of genuine experience without the crowds and performance that have come to characterise better-known destinations. A Koyasan calligraphy workshop with a monk as your instructor, attended by a handful of people rather than a tour bus group. A private cave bath in a UNESCO World Heritage spring designed for two. A mikan farm where the farmer’s wife hands you a plastic bag and points at the trees.
